content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue displaying values in the web editor. Although my software configuration is set to show time in hours, the data appears in minutes when accessed on the web editor.
It's difficult to provide a precise solution without reviewing your exact setup. Please upload your [product_name] program along with your [product_name] web editor project as a zipped file.
The folder attached below contains a sample of my configuration. I aim to display time in hours on the web editor, but the output is shown in minutes for some reason. Thank you for your assistance.

This matches my expectations. The operating hours counter is formatted as 'hh:mm', meaning the time base is minutes rather than hours. To display correctly, you need to configure the web editor to use the 'hh:mm' format.
Thank you for the guidance; everything is working correctly now. I appreciate your support and wish you a pleasant day.
Wishing you a good day as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants experienced confusion over time format visualization in the web editor when displaying operating hours from [product_name]. The anticipated view was in hours, but the editor presented values in minutes. This led to challenges until it was clarified that the operating hours counter outputs data in 'hh:mm' format, and matching the web editor configuration to this format resolved the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expected the software to display operating time in hours as set in their configuration and desired a straightforward transition from [product_name] to the web interface.
